**BookIt** — read any book in your own language. Free, open source, and it translates on your own device.

### New in 0.3.0
* 🎧 **Read aloud.** BookIt reads the page to you in the book's language using your device's voices, and turns the pages by itself.
* 📖 **Bilingual view.** Show the original under each translated paragraph. Tap the middle of the page, then **Show original too**.
* 🔥 **Reading streaks.** A daily goal, your streak and a weekly chart on Home. Share your reading week as an image.
* ❝ **Share a quote.** Long-press a page to turn a passage into an image for WhatsApp or Instagram. If the book is translated, the image shows the original too.
* 🇮🇳 **Menus in your language.** Use the app in हिन्दी, বাংলা, தமிழ், తెలుగు or मराठी (Settings → Menu language).
* 📚 **Ready-made translations.** Popular classics are already translated into Hindi, Tamil, Bengali, Telugu and Marathi. They appear on Home under *Ready to read in your language*.
* 🔔 BookIt now tells you when a new version is out.

### Download
* **Android:** `BookIt-android-arm64.apk` works on most phones. If it doesn't install, use `BookIt-android.apk` (works on all). You may need to allow "Install unknown apps". If Android says it can't update the app, uninstall the old version first.
* **Windows 10/11:** `BookIt-Setup-x.y.z.exe` (installer) or `BookIt-windows-x64.zip` (unzip and run `bookit.exe`).

### Everything else
* 78,000+ free classics, Trending now and bestsellers (with buy/borrow links), free modern fiction and Standard Ebooks
* A Kindle-style reader with pages, themes, fonts, bookmarks and contents
* On-device translation into 200 languages, including 20 Indian languages. The model is a one-time 1.35 GB download, then it works offline.

Translations are made by a machine translation model and may contain mistakes.

⭐ If you like BookIt, please [star it on GitHub](https://github.com/MohammedAnasAsif/BookIt). It helps other readers find it.
